svg.title: Hen house output wiring
svg.desc: ESP32-S3 pins wired to the L298N motor driver inputs, the XY-MOS light switch, status LEDs and buzzer.
svg.text: ESP32 pins on the left, outputs on the right. Follow each coloured line straight across.
GND rail: every LED and the buzzer returns here
Blue LED: the 5-10 ohm in the sketch comment can overload a GPIO. Use 100 ohm or more. Buzzer: check it draws 20 mA or less.
No separate ESP32-to-L298N ground wire is drawn: the grounds meet at the GND block (see 01-power).
Resistor values are in ohms and match the comments in Hen_House_V3_6.ino. LEDs: long leg toward the resistor, short leg toward GND.
Pin order is arranged for clarity. Find pins on your board by the GPIO numbers, not by position.
